acceptanceChanges: Initially required more than 10% heap reduction in every churn sample.
After an observed survivor failure, changed to more than 10% median paired reduction per workload/cycle group plus positive release in every sample.
After an observed mixed sample grew 21,724 bytes, removed per-sample positivity while retaining the median threshold and storage-retirement check.
Final matrix explicitly uses observe-only. The revised median threshold was selected after these observations; it is not a predeclared or calibrated acceptance pass.
